name: Skyworth SW-22SA
summary: Skyworth SW-22SA ships with Skyworth ads, demos and after-sale push apps. TidyTV is a free phone app that turns them off, with a backup and one-tap undo.
intro: This Skyworth set runs Google TV on Android TV 14. It ships with Skyworth content, ads, demos and preloads, telemetry and an after-sale app that can push APKs at start, plus Android ad services. The list also covers casting and local media apps that this owner does not use.

It was checked on the TV in October 2026. Live TV, HDMI, Chromecast and Assistant are kept on. TidyTV turns these off from your phone over Wi-Fi, saves a backup first and never deletes anything. The phone and TV need to be on the same Wi-Fi, and the TV asks you once to allow debugging.
keep: Live TV and the HDMI inputs
Bluetooth remote pairing and the quick menu
The Play Store and Play Services
notes: Network debugging can close on its own and show as offline. Reconnect to the TV if it drops.
If you forget and re-join Wi-Fi, the TV may get a new address.

faq.q: Will the voice button still work on my Skyworth SW-22SA?
faq.a: Yes. Google Assistant is kept on purpose.
Yes. Chromecast is kept. The unused local media apps are turned off.

faq.q: Can I get the old home screen back?
faq.a: Yes. Restore everything turns every app back on and puts the old home screen back in one tap.
